commands: node -e "const { readdirSync, rmSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const entry of readdirSync('packages/agent-plugin/skills')) if (entry !== 'tau') rmSync('packages/agent-plugin/skills/' + entry, { recursive: true, force: true })"

node -e "const { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const { resolve } = require('node:path'); mkdirSync('packages/agent-plugin/.dev', { recursive: true }); writeFileSync('packages/agent-plugin/.dev/cli.json', JSON.stringify({ argv: [resolve('node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs'), resolve('packages/cli/src/bin.ts')] }, null, 2) + '\n')"

metadata.description: The built viewer page in Chromium: the ext-apps basic-host harness (AppBridge, sandboxed frame, declared CSP) and the loopback page, against a real tau mcp. The tau mcp it spawns runs the CLI from source, so the plugins' copied wasm (STEP import's occt-import-js among them) is staged first. Named test:e2e so the nightly lane that installs Chromium selects it.
